visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene opens with a wide eye-level shot of a street-side fried chicken stall. A green awning covers the stall where customers on scooters wait. The lighting is natural overcast daylight. (2) The camera pans and cuts to a medium shot of a male worker in a black t-shirt and white mask. He is holding a smartphone to his ear while writing on a pad, suggesting a busy order-taking process. (3) A series of close-up shots follow, displaying multiple white paper bags filled with golden-brown, irregular-shaped fried chicken pieces. The texture appears highly crispy with some visible seasoning. (4) The visual transitions to the cooking area where a worker in a red headscarf and pink shirt uses metal tongs to transfer battered chicken into a stainless steel deep fryer. The background is a functional kitchen environment. (5) A hand holds up skewers of the fried chicken against the street background. The shots are stable with high saturation, emphasizing the reddish-brown color of the meat. (6) The final shot shows a yellow and red promotional sign detailing the menu and contact information for the shop.
